name: planning-flow
description: Plan-building flow that ends in one clean plan, never a story of revisions — a commit-stamped map of the codebase's structure, flows, patterns, and tests, parallel exploration, a zero-context review of the draft against the original ask, questions batched for the user, tickets with what/why/acceptance criteria/dependencies/size, spikes resolved on the spot, every decision logged with its reason, and a plain-text handoff to implementation.
